name: continuous-scroll
description: Scroll past the bottom of a file to jump into the next open tab, and past the top to jump back into the previous one - makes separate files feel like one continuous document.

continuousScroll.enabled.description: Enable jumping to the next/previous tab when scrolling past the bottom/top of a file.

continuousScroll.wrapAround.description: When at the last tab and scrolling past the bottom, wrap around to the first tab (and vice versa).

continuousScroll.triggerDelayMs.description: How long (in milliseconds) you must stay scrolled at the top/bottom edge before it switches tabs. Higher values make it feel less jarring - a quick flick past the edge won't trigger it, but pausing or continuing to scroll there will. Set to 0 to switch instantly (old behavior).

continuousScroll.edgeBufferLines.description: Extra blank lines you must scroll past the END of a file before the switch-to-next-tab countdown starts. Requires "editor.scrollBeyondLastLine" to be enabled, since that's what creates the blank space to scroll into. Only affects the bottom edge (going to the next tab) - there's no equivalent blank space above the first line, so the top edge uses triggerDelayMs alone.
